recipes.title: Slow-Cooked Pot Roast

source.name: Heart Healthy Recipe Guide - HFSA
source.location: Complete Meals & Main Dishes, Slow-Cooked Pot Roast

ingredients.name: beef top round roast, trimmed of fat and brought to room temperature
potatoes, unpeeled and cut into 2-inch chunks

steps: Heat the olive oil over medium heat in a large, heavy oven-safe pot, tilting to coat the bottom.
Add the beef roast and sear for 2 to 3 minutes on each side until evenly browned.
Season the seared beef with the salt and freshly cracked black pepper.
Scatter the chopped garlic, celery, potatoes, carrots, and sliced onion around the roast, then pour in the water.
Cover the pot tightly with its lid and transfer to the oven to bake for 2 hours.
Remove the beef to a cutting board, tent loosely with aluminum foil, and let rest for 15 minutes before thinly slicing.
Arrange the sliced beef on a serving platter, transfer the braised vegetables alongside using a slotted spoon, and spoon the warm pan juices over the meat.
recipes.notes: Equipment: large, heavy ovenproof pot with tight-fitting lid. Passive time: 1 hour resting at room temperature before searing, and 15 minutes resting under foil after cooking. The pan drippings and braising water create the natural pan sauce drizzled over the roast.
